name: GrabOn

sources.title: Homepage — India's coupons & deals marketplace (6.5M+ monthly visitors claimed); 'Submit Coupon / Merchant' modal in nav
Partner With Us — B2B affiliate/merchant partnership program with dedicated relationship managers

conditions: The free path is submitting a coupon/deal via the 'Submit Coupon / Merchant' modal — requires the product to actually offer a discount or coupon code
A product without a couponable offer has no natural listing; merchant onboarding goes through the affiliate partnership program instead
Audience is India-first (also US/UAE/CA editions) — deal-hunting consumers, not software buyers
requirements: A genuine coupon code, deal, or discount the product can honor
Coupon submissions go through a site modal (JS-rendered; likely requires a free login via Google)
Merchant-level presence (own store page) requires the partnership program — affiliate/CPA terms negotiated with their team
They claim 3.5K+ merchant partners, 10M+ newsletter subscribers
preparation: A discount code for the product (e.g. launch promo) and its terms
A Google account for site login if the submit modal requires it
For partnership: affiliate commission capability (CPA) and merchant contact details
workflow: Open https://grabon.in/ and use the Submit → 'Submit Coupon / Merchant' modal (JS-only, use an interactive browser)
Submit the coupon with code, discount terms, and expiry
Alternatively, for a store page: apply via https://www.grabon.in/partnership/ or contact@grabon.in
SaaS deals appear under relevant coupon pages; GrabOn also runs an 'AI Tools' specialty deals section
watchFor: Not a launch directory — this is a coupon marketplace; only works if you can offer a real discount
Submit modal is JS-driven (javascript:void triggers); no static form
Affiliate CPA model means merchant partnerships are commercial agreements, not free listings
India-centric consumer audience — poor fit for B2B SaaS exposure unless the deal appeals to consumers
countsAsLive: The coupon/deal appears on a GrabOn store or category page, or the merchant has its own /stores/<name> page
unknowns: Whether user-submitted coupons are reviewed before appearing
Partnership program minimums and CPA terms
Whether merchant store pages can be obtained without the affiliate program
